operators.name: CodeFenceUnclosed
operators.rationale: Forgetting to close a fenced code block swallows subsequent content.

operators.name: HeaderMalformed
operators.rationale: Skipping heading levels breaks document outline structure.

operators.name: HTMLTagUnclosed
operators.rationale: Unclosed HTML tags break pandoc and many Markdown renderers.

operators.name: ImageBroken
operators.rationale: Referencing a missing image is a common documentation mistake.

operators.name: LinkBroken
operators.rationale: Unclosed markdown links are a common authoring typo.

operators.name: MathBlockUnclosed
operators.rationale: Unclosed display-math $$ breaks pandoc and many MD processors.

operators.name: TableMalformed
operators.rationale: Broken table separator rows cause markdown table render failures.

operators.name: YAMLFrontmatterBroken
operators.rationale: Broken YAML frontmatter delimiters confuse static site generators.

operators.name: ArgumentDrop
operators.rationale: Authors forget a required argument (e.g. \frac{a} missing second arg).

operators.name: BraceDrop
operators.rationale: Unclosed groups are among the most common TeX errors ('Runaway argument', 'Extra }, or forgotten $').

operators.name: BraceStray
operators.rationale: An unbalanced '{' silently swallows following tokens, a frequent copy-paste error.

operators.name: DocumentClassDrop
operators.rationale: Author accidentally deletes the preamble class declaration.

operators.name: CommandTypo
operators.rationale: Undefined control sequence from a realistic author typo.

operators.name: CsvFormatException
operators.rationale: Author has wrong column count in CSV data used by csvsimple/pgfplotstable.

operators.name: EnvRename
operators.rationale: Mismatched \begin/\end names raise 'Environment ... undefined' and 'Missing \endgroup'.

operators.name: EnvironmentSwap
operators.rationale: Authors pick the wrong environment (itemize vs enumerate, table vs tabular).

operators.name: EnvUnclosed
operators.rationale: Forgetting to close an environment produces '\begin{...} ended by \end{document}'.

operators.name: FontSpecRemove
operators.rationale: Engine-specific package dependency: fontspec fails on pdfLaTeX.

operators.name: FontSwap
operators.rationale: Authors apply the wrong font command (textbf ↔ textit ↔ texttt).

operators.name: GlossaryUndefined
operators.rationale: Author forgets to define a glossary entry before using \gls.

operators.name: HyperrefDriverConflict
operators.rationale: Driver auto-detection failure from premature hyperref setup.

operators.name: ItemMisplaced
operators.rationale: Copy-paste error placing \item outside itemize/enumerate.

operators.name: LabelDuplicate
operators.rationale: Copy-paste error duplicating a \label key causes multiply-defined labels.

operators.name: LevelShift
operators.rationale: Authors get heading levels wrong (section → subsection).

operators.name: MathDollar
operators.rationale: Missing '$' triggers 'Missing $ inserted' and cascades across the rest of the file.

operators.name: MathDisplay
operators.rationale: An unclosed \[ leaves math mode running to end-of-file.

operators.name: MathOperatorSwap
operators.rationale: Authors pick the wrong mathematical operator (cup/cap, sin/cos, sum/prod).

operators.name: MathRelationSwap
operators.rationale: Authors confuse inequality direction in mathematical expressions.

operators.name: PackageDrop
operators.rationale: Author removes a package that is still required by macros in the body.

operators.name: PackageOrder
operators.rationale: hyperref must be loaded last — loading it early is a classic author mistake.

operators.name: ReferenceUndefined
operators.rationale: Author renames a label but forgets to update refs.

operators.name: ShellEscapeReq
operators.rationale: Authors use minted without knowing the --shell-escape flag is required.

operators.name: UnitChange
operators.rationale: Off-by-one in spacing/font size values (12pt → 11pt, 2cm → 3cm).

operators.name: ContentBlockUnclosed
operators.rationale: Unclosed content block ] is a common Typst syntax error.

operators.name: DictKeyDrop
operators.rationale: Dropping a required dictionary key breaks function calls.

operators.name: FuncUnclosed
operators.rationale: Unclosed function call parentheses break Typst parsing.

operators.name: FontChange
operators.rationale: Setting a non-existent font is a common cross-platform Typst error.

operators.name: HeadingOrphan
operators.rationale: Accidentally deleting section body leaves an orphan heading.

operators.name: ImportDrop
operators.rationale: Removing an import breaks subsequent uses of imported symbols.

operators.name: ListMalformed
operators.rationale: Removing list markers produces invalid or unintended document structure.

operators.name: MathUnclosed
operators.rationale: Unclosed math mode $ cascades through the rest of the document.

operators.name: PageSizeChange
operators.rationale: Invalid page paper size causes Typst set-rule errors.

operators.name: PackageDrop
operators.rationale: Removing a used package import breaks the document at compile time.

operators.name: RefUndefined
operators.rationale: Referencing an undefined label produces Typst reference errors.

operators.name: SetRuleInvalid
operators.rationale: Invalid #set rule values are a frequent Typst configuration mistake.

operators.name: StringUnclosed
operators.rationale: Unclosed string literals break Typst compilation.

operators.name: TypeWrong
operators.rationale: Passing the wrong type to a function argument fails Typst type checking.

operators.name: VarUndefined
operators.rationale: Referencing an undefined variable is a common Typst authoring error.
